title: Drop a field with a migration
prompt: Notes no longer need the `color` field: remove it from the notes model. This project deploys with migrations: add the migration file migrations/0002_drop_color.sql with exactly the SQL `kairo db migrate drop_color --allow-drop` would generate, and update migrations/snapshot.json the same way, so that running `kairo db migrate` afterwards finds no changes. You cannot run commands.
